messages.subject: Error in the Height/Weight Example?
parts:
Hello Shiny-Community,

Thanks for developing this wonderful tool - I can see it getting a lot of use. 

I have a question about one of the height-weight example that is found on the homepage(http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/). If you download the code or if you look at the glimmer-hosted app (http://glimmer.rstudio.com/winston/heightweight/) the sidebar is on the right and the graphs are sitting low on the screen. I imagine this is due to a non-closure in one of the html files but as I am unfamiliar with the internala, any help on getting this fixed would be appreciated.

thanks,
zach cp
